$comment: The mailbox's thread list, GET /projects/{p}/threads?status=<s>, as it is served today. The row is
store.Thread encoded with no json tags (api/internal/store/store.go), so its keys are the Go field
names. The scripts below read those exact keys; a reader that misses a key gets an empty value, not
an error (role-relay would relay nothing: an empty subject never matches [for <role>]). The mailbox's
test api/internal/api/contract_test.go (TestThreadListKeysMatchSample) reads this file and fails if
the served keys change. Lowercase tags are a later, separate change: change this sample first, then
every reader below in the same change. Sample rule and index: contracts/README.md.

row_types.Subject: string, empty when the thread has none

readers.note: open and closed lists; its test fake hand-encodes the same keys (~/claudecode/tests/role-relay/test_own_thread.py:49)
tolerant: reads id or ID, created_at or CreatedAt
Deltagos's ThreadHead pins the same keys with explicit json tags

not_readers: ~/claudecode/scripts/factory/check.sh reads /health (agent, watcher, deaf_reason), not the thread list; that is health-golden.json
the UI (~/agent-slack/ui/app.js) reads /health and /threads/{id}, not the list
record_differs: The record's alias /projects/{cell}/threads serves ThreadSummary with lowercase keys (id, subject, status, since_decision, created_at), adds last_at and messages, drops project_id, and lists every live thread by default (record internal/model/health.go, internal/service/read_service.go). No reader above is pointed at the record today.
